top_stories.title: How China built the world's first wind-powered underwater data centre off Shanghai
top_stories.rephrased_article: **China** has launched the world's first wind-powered underwater data center in Shanghai, a collaboration between **Shanghai Hailanyun Technology** and government agencies. The facility uses seawater as a cooling medium to reduce energy consumption and land requirements, achieving a Power Usage Effectiveness (PUE) below 1.15. This project, which draws electricity from offshore wind power, aims to provide sustainable solutions for data center needs while addressing the growing demand for AI computing in China.  The facility is expected to play a role in shaping the future of sustainable digital infrastructure globally.

top_stories.title: Trump says Iran downed Apache helicopter, ‘US must respond to attack’ | World News - The Indian Express
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Donald Trump** claimed on Truth Social that an American Apache helicopter was shot down by **Iran** while patrolling the Strait of Hormuz, prompting a threat of retaliation. The US Central Command confirmed two crew members were rescued and are in stable condition after their helicopter went down near Oman.  The incident reportedly marks America's first loss of an Apache helicopter since the war with **Iran** began in February.

top_stories.title: Soil at Shiv Shakti Point chemically close to lunar meteorite that hit Antarctica | India News - The Indian Express
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Chandrayaan-3**, India's moon mission, has discovered a close chemical relationship between the soil at its landing site near the Moon's South Pole and a lunar meteorite found in Antarctica.  The study, led by researchers from the **Physical Research Laboratory (PRL)**, suggests that the soil at Shiv Shakti Point is similar to the ALHA 81005 meteorite, which fell on Earth about a million years ago. The findings support the theory of a lunar magma ocean and provide evidence for the redistribution of crustal materials by impact events. This information could be valuable for future rover missions aiming to uncover insights into the Moon's early history.

top_stories.title: NASA unveils Artemis III astronauts to test technology for future moon landing | World News - The Indian Express
top_stories.rephrased_article: **NASA** announced the crew for its Artemis III mission, which will focus on testing the Orion capsule's docking with lunar landers. The crew consists of **Randy Bresnik**, **Frank Rubio**, **Andre Douglas**, and **Luca Parmitano**.  The two-week demonstration is scheduled for 2027 and aims to prepare for a lunar landing in 2028.  **SpaceX** and **Blue Origin** are competing to deliver the landers, with Blue Origin recently experiencing a setback during an engine test.

top_stories.title: Terror Hideout To Purple Revolution: How Lavender Changed Fate Of A Bhaderwah in Jammu and Kashmir
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Bhadarwah**, a town in Jammu and Kashmir's Doda district, is transforming from a former terror hideout into a lavender farming hub.  The cultivation of lavender has provided farmers with new income sources and attracted domestic and international buyers, boosting tourism in the region. **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** highlighted this initiative during his "Mann Ki Baat" program, recognizing the success of the lavender revolution in Bhaderwah. The initiative has also been praised by **Dr Jitendra Singh**, who noted that it provided a new economic opportunity for the region and proved that entrepreneurship doesn't require advanced degrees.

top_stories.title: NDA Constituents To Meet Tomorrow For 12th Anniversary Of Modi Government
top_stories.rephrased_article: A meeting of the **National Democratic Alliance (NDA)** will be held on Wednesday to celebrate 12 years of the government's rule and Prime Minister Narendra Modi becoming the longest continuously serving elected prime minister of India. The event, attended by all constituents of the ruling alliance besides top BJP leadership, including Prime Minister Modi, is expected to see a resolution praising his record.  Senior Union ministers like Rajnath Singh, Amit Shah, J P Nadda, and Shivraj Singh Chouhan are among those expected to attend.  The meeting will focus on boosting 'Ease of Living', 'Ease of Doing Business', and reforms towards realizing the shared dream of a 'Viksit Bharat' by 2047.

top_stories.title: 8 Burnt Alive In Fire At Illegal Cracker Godown In Jaipur
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Eight** individuals were killed in a fire that erupted at an illegal cracker godown in Khoh Nagoriyan area. The fire, which started after an explosion, engulfed the small house where combustible materials were stored. **Chief Minister Bhajanlal Sharma**, **Congress leader Ashok Gehlot**, and **Jaipur Collector Sandesh Nayak** offered condolences to the victims' families.  Police Commissioner **Sachin Mittal** stated that the house was being used as a storage facility for firecrackers, while MLA **Amin Kagzi** accused authorities of negligence in allowing such a hazardous facility to operate near residential areas.

top_stories.title: Mohali Man Kills Ex-Lover, Slits Own Throat, Reaches Court Days Later
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Harjinder Singh Mann**, who killed his ex-partner Dimple inside a logistics firm in Mohali on June 4th, appeared at court walking unaided despite extensive throat injuries he sustained from self-inflicted wounds.  The incident occurred after Dimple ended their relationship and refused to discuss their past, leading to persistent harassment. **Mann** was accused of stabbing Dimple multiple times before turning the knife on himself.  Police are investigating the case and gathering statements from witnesses.

top_stories.title: Italy’s foreign minister slams Israel’s Ben-Gvir over ‘flip-flop’ comments | Gaza News | Al Jazeera
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Antonio Tajani**, **Italy’s Foreign Minister**, condemned **Itamar Ben-Gvir**, the Israeli National Security Minister, for his "unacceptable" comments regarding Italy's investigation into the treatment of activists detained by Israel.  Ben-Gvir had previously criticized Italy's geographical shape and sparked international outrage after a video surfaced showing him mocking and mistreating activists in Ashdod port. **The EU** is considering sanctions against Ben-Gvir, while **Italy** has suspended its defense agreement with Israel and remains one of the strongest allies of Israel in Europe despite growing tensions.

top_stories.title: 'Not Done By Us': Surat Civic Body Distances Itself From Nasirnagar Demolition
top_stories.rephrased_article: The **Surat Municipal Corporation (SMC)** has denied any involvement in the demolition of homes in Nasirnagar, Surat.  **Ashish J Nayak**, Deputy Commissioner of the **SMC**, stated that his team was only there for boundary demarcation and that machinery was already operating when they arrived. He also clarified that the police and SOG were not summoned by the **SMC** and that the standard procedure for demolition notices is followed, which includes providing residents with advance notice. The state government is investigating the incident to determine who authorized the demolition.
